name: Brawl Stars RNG
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Brawl Stars RNG! ⭐

Open boxes, test your luck, and unlock powerful brawlers!
Chase rare pulls and work your way toward becoming a true Brawler Master 🥷🔥

🎁 Box Opening Gameplay
Every box contains brawlers of different rarities — some easy, some legendary-level rare.

🍀 Premium Perk
Premium players get a permanent +200 Luck Boost (boosts stack!).

📜 190 brawlers available — can you collect them all?

⭐ Like & favourite to support future updates!

DISCLAIMER: This experience is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Supercell. This content is created under Supercell’s Fan Content Policy.
